calls.video_title: A Dip Like This Only Comes Once a Decade
calls.price_at_call: 3-yr forecast ~$1,600 per $1,000; tightest estimates of the group (first tracked BWB call)
calls.thesis: CONDITIONAL_BUY, first tracked — makes the traffic-directing chip on ~45% of new server memory sticks; sales +22% while memory makers multiplied, then dragged -47% since June on a price spike it never got paid for. CONDITIONAL_BUY — buy in pieces (dollar-cost average on the way down), not all at once; only while the memory shortage holds.
calls.base_case: Steady-price chip business does not depend on memory prices, so it should not cool off when memory prices do.
calls.bull_case: Steady earnings stream re-rates as the memory story broadens.
calls.bear_case: Smallest forecast upside of the group; it captures none of the memory-price upside.
